Why switch from QR Code Monkey at all?

Monkey's free tool is excellent for fixed codes. The switch is for everything after printing: editing a destination, seeing scan counts, making codes in batches, or generating barcodes — none of which the free tool does.
Do my printed Monkey codes stop working if I switch?
No. Static codes you already printed keep working forever, wherever they were made, because the destination lives inside the pattern. You only remake the codes you want to edit or measure.
Do I need an account?
Not for static codes — FreeQrly static codes need no sign-up, same as Monkey's generator. You sign in free only when you want dynamic codes, statistics, or a dashboard.
